metadata.name: Japanese Imperial Ultranationalism
metadata.description: The late imperial Japanese doctrine of kokutai: emperor-centred national unity, imperial mission and mobilisation. It is distinct from German Nazism and from every earlier or later form of Japanese nationalism.
metadata.period: Official kokutai and imperial mobilisation doctrine, 1937–1945
metadata.scope: The official late-imperial political doctrine articulated in Kokutai no hongi and national mobilisation, checked against contemporary documents. It excludes a blanket identification with Nazism and does not equate all Japanese people, all Shinto believers or every ultranationalist faction with this doctrine.
metadata.phrase: A society united in service to the emperor and national polity, coordinating education, economic life and public duties to sustain Japan’s imperial mission.
